about.title: About
about.intro: StockHome helps you manage your household stock: products, categories, locations and shopping list.
about.sourcesIntroBefore: When you scan a barcode, StockHome automatically queries the collaborative, open-source databases of the
about.sourcesIntroAfter: project, in this order, until it gets a match:

sources.openFoodFacts: Food products: ingredients, Nutri-Score, nutrient levels, allergens...
sources.openProductsFacts: General-purpose database, used as a last resort for products not covered above.

about.licensesIntro: In accordance with Open Food Facts' terms of use, we indicate that all product information displayed in StockHome (name, brand, categories, Nutri-Score, photos...) comes from these collaborative, open-source databases.

sponsor.title: Support StockHome
sponsor.intro: StockHome is a personal project, developed and maintained in my free time.
sponsor.supportText: If the app is useful to you day to day, a donation helps cover hosting and domain name costs, and keep developing new features. It's in no way mandatory — StockHome stays free and ad-free no matter what.
sponsor.footer: Thank you for your support, whatever form it takes — your feedback and suggestions are just as valuable!

platforms.kofi: One-off or monthly donations, very low fees, set up in 5 minutes.
platforms.buyMeACoffee: Very popular alternative to Ko-fi, customizable page, one-off or recurring donations.
platforms.githubSponsors: No fees taken by GitHub (only Stripe's) -- consistent if the code is hosted on GitHub.
platforms.liberapay: Non-profit platform, designed for recurring donations to free/open projects.
platforms.paypal: The simplest and most universally known option for a quick one-off donation.
